mapper.select: select sr.id, any_value(sr.sort) as `sort`, any_value(sr.role_name) as `role_name`, any_value(sr.role_key) as `role_key`, any_value(sr.data_scope) as `data_scope`, any_value(sr.create_time) as `create_time` from sys_role sr left join sys_user_role sur on sr.id = sur.role_id left join sys_user su on sur.user_id = su.id where sr.del_flag = false and @isDataScope group by sr.id order by sort

select distinct sr.id, sr.role_name, sr.role_key, sr.data_scope, sr.create_time from sys_role sr left join sys_user_role sur on sr.id = sur.role_id where sr.del_flag = false
and sur.user_id = #{userId}
